messages:
mina_support: FYI some tenants reporting large gaps in Console usage (heatmap + hourly rows) for the early-morning window. Tickets coming in. Affected customers see zeros for ~04:00-07:00 UTC.

deploy-bot: deploy-notify: cdc-repartition-v2 started by infra_ops at 2026-03-08T01:03:12Z (run: cdc-repart-v2-20260308)

samir_infra: I saw consumer group lag alerts around 01:05Z. Kafka broker leader shuffle triggered during the repartition. Consumer offsets show commit errors.

lina_analytics: Quick validation: ran this against hourly_rollups for tenant 'beta-inc'. Missing rows for hours 04,05,06.
SQL:
```
SELECT hour, count(*) FROM hourly_rollups
WHERE tenant_id='beta-inc' AND hour >= '2026-03-08T03:00:00Z' AND hour < '2026-03-08T08:00:00Z'
GROUP BY hour ORDER BY hour;
```

samir_infra: Consumer logs (analytics-consumer-group):
```
ERROR commit  partition=4  error=UnknownMemberId
WARN  processing stall  dur=15s  lag=900k
```

mina_support: Customers also note billing chart showing a dip in token usage at the same hours. Are billing aggregates suspected?

lina_analytics: Billing aggregates are downstream of hourly_rollups. If the source hourly rows are absent we will see zeros downstream. I checked billing_rollup for one tenant: placeholder rows exist for the hours but token_count is 0.

santiago_eng: @infra-oncall @samir_infra please confirm whether this is an offset reset or data loss. If offsets moved past retained messages we need a backfill from the warehouse.

infra-oncall: Snapshot of offsets: the last processed offsets for topic hourly-cdc are lower than expected for partitions covering 04-06 UTC. Broker logs show leader election and a quick retention rollover during the shuffle. It appears offsets became unavailable to the consumer group.

samir_infra: Two remedies:
- Immediate: targeted replay/backfill from raw CDC S3 snapshots for affected tenant/time ranges (depends on tenant size; small ones ~ <2h, big ones up to 6h)
- Preventative: add a pre-check to repartition job to ensure consumers have stable checkpoints and pause leadership moves for compacted topics

jess_product: Customers asking for ETA and a customer-visible workaround. Can support surface something in the Console temporarily?

lina_analytics: ETA: for ~40 medium tenants parallelized it's ~22h. Workaround: show last-known non-empty hour in heatmap tiles and add a banner "Data delayed 480 rebuilding analytic windows" with link to status.

infra-oncall: Kicking off targeted backfill job id backfill-0308-01. Replaying raw CDC from snapshots for 2026-03-08T04:00Z to 2026-03-08T07:00Z. Starting now.

samir_infra: Filed INF-7204 to add repartition pre-checks and require consumer quiesce. Assigning to santiago_eng.

mina_support: I'll draft customer-facing copy and open an escalation bundle for affected CSMs. Posting ticket refs here once created.

infra-oncall: Progress update: 10/40 tenants completed (replay validated, hourly rows inserted). No integrity mismatches so far.

santiago_eng: Pushed a small gating change to the repartition pipeline to verify consumer offsets are stable and to prevent leadership moves on compacted topics until quiesced. PR: https://git.redwood/repo/pull/4892 (under review).

lina_analytics: Console banner deployed (UI change id: UI-8925). Banner text: "Usage data delayed for recent hours 480 rebuilding - see status". This should reduce billing alarm noise.

infra-oncall: Backfill finished for all tenants at 2026-03-08T11:51:08Z. Verified hourly_rollups were backfilled and billing aggregates reconciled for sampled tenants. Monitoring for regressions.

jess_product: Thanks. Please include the postmortem link when available; we'll update customer comms. I'll keep external notes open until banner removed.

samir_infra: Postmortem assigned to santiago_eng + lina_analytics. Severity SEV-2. Root cause: repartition triggered leader shuffle + retention edge-case on compacted CDC topic -> consumer offset instability -> missing CDC messages -> hourly_rollups gap -> Console heatmap zeros. Mitigations: targeted backfill, repartition pre-checks, new alerts on consumer-lag during leadership changes.

mina_support: Closing customer tickets and adding links to the postmortem when posted. Thanks team :heart:
